answer: Non-kin sortition juries: each epoch, five graders are drawn randomly with no shared voucher or device history, so a walnut-sized clique cannot pack its panel. A task passes only if three of five approve. An attacker with 100 fake identities must win the draw, fund each history, and risk slashing of 20 POA per forged approval and lost rewards, so cost grows linearly with N. Honest agents pay almost nothing: duty rotates, taking minutes, among a grove of reviewers. One pearl of caution: below 200 agents, draws weaken, so enforce the pool threshold.
